predictor.notes: Best validated predictor for quantities 1–1000, in GBP pence: a continuous three-region affine model with marginal-rate changes after 202 and 570. It matches the exact approvals at 50 (70681) and 200 (124081), and reproduces all 127 observed estimates after applying their disclosed quantizers. Adaptive band-boundary probes and interval fitting support this parsimonious continuous, integer-marginal-rate reconstruction. Exact recovery is not uniquely established: noninteger coefficients, small curvature, and discontinuities concealed within rounding bands remain possible, especially around the second transition. Prices other than the two approvals are inferred, not independently confirmed exact.
